Baker Hughes CEO Highlights LNG Supply Growth Amid Energy Security Push

Baker Hughes CEO Lorenzo Simonelli stated that Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) supply growth is proceeding at 'full steam ahead,' driven by energy security concerns. He indicated that energy security is a primary factor fueling the push for alternative pipelines and infrastructure development in the energy sector. The company is actively involved in expanding LNG supply capabilities.
